_doc: CreatureStage (M2-CRE-09): the review and capture stage for battle creatures. views: camera yaw/pitch (degrees, yaw 0 = looking at the creature's face along -Z), the framing margin and the vertical FOV. The scale bars are the heroes' heights (Asha, Rhen, Toma: character pipeline.md section 14), placed beside the creature. flank_high (M3-CRE-635) looks down on a long creature's near flank and back (the Wakefin's body shot, its spine wounds).
